scope: Complete recursive Chapter32 open problems reader revision

groups.title: Open problem scope and known equation/topology/trace/kernel regimes
groups.source_reader_review: Reviewed the exact threshold problem at zero lower mass separately from positive-lower-mass, closed-factor and radial cases. Scalar uniqueness, potential uniqueness and exponential selection remain distinct. The root now explicitly restricts current determinant and divisorial constraints to dimension at least two. Ordinary and ideal envelopes, all obstacles, positive-volume metrics and zero-volume product loci remain separate. Original growing-jet question is retained with its scoped solution; no other formal problem is closed.

groups.title: Trace versus determinant collapse
groups.source_reader_review: Reviewed normalized trace threshold, determinant denominator and the dimensional scaling distinction. The actual radial comparison propositions were reread: powers of the localized balanced metrics converge as currents; volume-minimizing tests approach the bigness threshold only in dimension three.

groups.title: Closed geometry and related open directions
groups.source_reader_review: Closed nef positivity and bounded mass are conditional on the stated top intersection hypothesis. Nonclosed positive volume does not decide closed bigness. Flow locus, elliptic completeness, balanced/pluriclosed metrics, Morse subtraction and OT fluctuations retain their hypotheses and open general cases; literature dependencies retain historical review scope.

groups.title: Primitive elliptic bundles and separated mass
groups.source_reader_review: Reviewed primitive curvature, fiber normalization, cubic integration identity, exact upper mass, separated positivity, periodic variance sharpness and K3 period/curve argument. Separated lower bounds do not establish lower mass for all potentials; the K3 construction still uses its cited period and Kahler-cone results.

groups.title: Parallel torsion positivity
groups.source_reader_review: Reviewed finite-dimensional parallel pairing, differential projection, holonomy averages and positive root. Constant pointwise trace gives compact positive affine slice with determinant zero on boundary; interior volume maximum is balanced and pluriclosed, hence Kahler. General balanced/pluriclosed conjecture is not asserted resolved.

groups.title: Pluriclosed deformation
groups.source_reader_review: Reviewed elliptic Aeppli operator principal symbol and harmonic quotient, orthogonal closed projection, constant-rank spectral perturbation and positivity persistence. Constancy of h_A remains required; the result supplies no balanced metric or additional curvature conditions.
